title.narrative: Support for the 2030 Agenda in Brazil

description.narrative:
UNOPS implements activities to promote the social and economic transformation of communities, collaborating with the 2030 Agenda, to benefit societies and individuals impacted by the violation of labour rights in Brazil.

UNOPS will provide a combination of procurement, grant management, infrastructure, and project management services, organized into 14 components:
1. Strengthening Entrepreneurial Logistics for Original Peoples and Traditional Communities
2. Support indigenous education in the State of Pará
3. Implementation of grants, procurement, training and infrastructure in Rondonia and Acre
4. Support capacity-building in information technology for original peoples, traditional communities and peripheral communities
5. Support economic empowerment of women in the Garment Industry in São Paulo
6. Implementation of infrastructure and procurement for the Pastoral Migrant Center in Cuiabá
7. Implementation of procurement in Joinville
8. Implementation of grants and procurement in Criciuma
9. Implementation of grants, procurement and infrastructure in Florianopolis
10. Implementation of grants, procurement and training in Santa Catarina
11. Implementation of grants, procurement and training in Maringa
12. Implementation of procurement and training in Teofilo Otoni
13. Implementation of grants, procurement and training in Macapá
14. Implementation of grants, procurement, training and infrastructure in Santarém
